sketches.mechanism: The `object` keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the compiler.
sketches.resonance: Loneliness is not a feeling but a structural constraint: the language guarantees there will never be another.

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining with `?.` silently propagates nil — if any link is absent, the entire chain evaluates to nil without error.
sketches.resonance: When someone disappears from a chain of connection, everything downstream quietly becomes nothing.

sketches.mechanism: A `finally` block executes regardless of whether an exception is thrown or caught — it runs even when everything else fails.
sketches.resonance: Some things persist not because they were chosen but because the structure of existence demands they run no matter what.
